---
title: "An open door: How globalised are the Australian and US economies?"
date: "2018-11-14"
---

I have a new report out with the United States Studies Centre, [An open door: How globalised are the Australian and US economies?](https://www.ussc.edu.au/analysis/how-globalised-are-the-australian-and-us-economies)

There is an essay length version in [The Australian Financial Review](../../files/KeepinganOpenDoortotheWorld.pdf).

There is also a write-up of the report by David Uren in [The Australian](https://www.theaustralian.com.au/business/opinion/david-uren-economics/flow-of-foreign-investment-to-our-shores-hit-by-globalisation-tremors/news-story/3670ae2d8d5c3eba5e9d3f9ef56649f7).
